meanrev.name: Mean reversion (RSI 2)
meanrev.tagline: Short, sharp pullbacks in stocks that are still in a long-term uptrend.
meanrev.exitRule: Close back above the 5-bar average, or 10 trading days

trend.name: Trend following (breakout)
trend.tagline: Stocks breaking out to new highs in an established uptrend, held until the trend ends.
trend.exitRule: Close below the 20-bar low, with a stop 2 ATRs below entry

momentum.name: Momentum (12 minus 1 month)
momentum.tagline: The strongest performers of the past year, checked once a month.
momentum.exitRule: Monthly check: momentum no longer in the top 25% or below the 200-day average

rebound.name: Channel rebound
rebound.tagline: Fairly valued large caps trading sideways, near the floor of their range.
rebound.exitRule: Target at the channel midline, stop 3% below the floor, or 10 trading days
